component.name: VeyAmux
component.summary: Low-latency capture-card viewer and video player with GPU enhancement

description.p: VeyAmux shows the picture from a capture card or plays a video file and enhances it on the GPU with very low latency: the capture frame is converted, enhanced and displayed entirely in Vulkan.

ul.li: Upscaling with Lanczos, AMD FSR 1, NVIDIA NIS or AMD FSR 3.1
Noise reduction (spatial, temporal), sharpening, FXAA and colour controls
HDR capture and HDR video, tone-mapped to SDR or shown on an HDR display (experimental), VRR pacing
Lossless Scaling frame generation through lsfg-vk (optional)
Instant replay, recording and screenshots with hardware encoding
